title: Romp
summary: ROMP, noun [a different spelling of ramp. See Ramp and Romance.] 1. A rude girl who indulges in boisterous play. 2. Rude play or frolic. ROMP loving miss is haul'd about in gallantry robust. ROMP, ver

inlines.v: ROMP, noun [a different spelling of ramp. See Ramp and Romance.] 1. A rude girl who indulges in boisterous play. 2. Rude play or frolic. ROMP loving miss is haul'd about in gallantry robust. ROMP, verb intransitive To play rudely and boisterously; to leap and frisk about in play.
